note: Standard Chartered Sri Lanka's most important features document (RB/CASA/MID-ENG/2019/08, the version it publishes): a charge of 650 rupees in a month whose average balance falls below 25,000 rupees on the Super Value Savings Account. Seylan Bank's cheaper regular savings account is for Sri Lankan citizens only, so isn't taken.
